title: AA Academy module
description: docs/learn/modules/<ID>-<slug>/module.yaml. A module is one objective area of 30 to 120 minutes; its lessons point at source sections by reference and pin their hashes. Format: docs/learn/README.md. Checked by tools/docs/check_learn.py (AA-1104).

id.description: Module code from the learning paths (GUIDE-13 §3), e.g. F3, E12, A4.

tier.description: Who may read it: staff (every staff role) or partner (agency owners and agents). Decision D13.

status.description: draft until the tech lead approved it; active when learners see it; retired when it is withdrawn.

version.description: Semantic version: patch for wording, minor for a new lesson, major when objectives or quiz items change (major triggers recertification for required modules).

owner.description: Role slug of the module owner; nghiep stands for the tech lead role (docs/STYLE.md).

languages.description: Languages the lessons exist in; en is the source, a translation is <lesson>.vi.md (decision D5).

objectives.description: After the module the learner can ... (one line each).

prerequisites.description: Module IDs to complete first; a module not written yet must be planned in a path.

quiz.description: The quiz file next to module.yaml.

lab.description: Optional hands-on lab file (P4b); labs stay closed until the lab provisioner exists.

file.description: lessons/<NN>-<slug>.md; the lesson body, no front-matter, first line is the H1 title.

type.description: GUIDE-13 §4.1 lesson types (quiz and lab are module files).

sources.description: The sections the lesson teaches from. Never copied: the reader renders the live section.

ref.description: doc:<catalog id>[#anchor], adr:<NNNN>[#anchor], skill:<name>#anchor, steering:<name>#anchor or context:<repo>#anchor.

sha.description: First 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the section, written by check_learn.py --pin.
